title: Non-authorizing status-only notification
description: Fixed-field status notice. There is deliberately no free-form text, URL, endpoint, path, command, review comment or digest field.

repository_id.description: Operator-assigned notification-safe identifier. Dots, slashes, colons and at-signs are refused so a hostname, URL or webhook path cannot be carried here; runs of 32 or more alphanumerics are refused as token- or digest-like. This is a shape check, not a secret detector.

occurred_at.description: UTC timestamp supplied by the trusted caller; the library never reads a clock.
